name: Hardy Lawn Furniture
old_description: Since 1993, Hardy Lawn Furniture has been your go-to place for durable and diverse outdoor furniture. From swings and gliders to practical storage solutions and comfy dining sets, we’ve got your patio needs covered. The versatility of our offerings guarantees a style solution for every homeowner in the Midwest. Join the community of satisfied customers today and transform your outdoor space into a masterpiece of quality comfort.
about:
Hardy Lawn Furniture was founded in 1993 in Iowa City, Iowa, as a family-owned business specializing in Amish-crafted outdoor furniture. The company began by offering handcrafted pieces built by skilled Amish and Mennonite artisans, establishing a reputation for quality in Central Iowa.

The company manufactures a range of outdoor products including gliders, chairs, picnic tables, swings, dining sets, benches, storage sheds, run-in sheds, detached garages, playhouses, and PlayMor playsets. Every item is built to order in the company's workshops, allowing extensive customization of materials such as wood or poly lumber, colors, finishes, and design features. Assembly uses stainless steel hardware for durability.

Hardy Lawn Furniture serves residential homeowners across the Midwest, with a focus on Central Iowa. Customers visit the showroom on Naples Avenue to select and customize pieces for backyard living, storage, and recreation.

The business operates under the motto "A quality product at an affordable price," emphasizing bespoke craftsmanship and a 10-year warranty against defects in workmanship or materials. The personalized, built-to-order approach and Amish construction methods are cited as key differentiators.
